Owner-requested paper and stationery extension within unreleased ddn-next-1: shared canonical shadow gains optional silhouette/opacity/lift and omission defaults; style.paper and ordered decorations are presentation-only and CSS/default eligible. Existing semantic types, statuses and omitted appearance remain unchanged.

Owner-requested deterministic background textures within unreleased ddn-next-1: nullable background.texture on workareas, definitions, appearances, views, placements and documents. Bounded paper/linen/grid/dots vector tiles preserve background colour, original shapes, hit geometry and clips; no executable markup or external resources.

Owner-requested new-document modes within unreleased ddn-next-1: explicit entry-file workarea.mode standalone limits the active include closure to one view/document and follows its bounds. Omission preserves existing multi-view workarea behavior. This is an opt-in capability; no existing default changes or private participation capabilities are introduced.

Owner-requested view-surface layouts within unreleased ddn-next-1: explicit view surface.preset selects dynamic or fixed TV dashboard recipes. Surface dimensions, scale, fit and padding are overridable; recipe paint and typography are standard-tier defaults below CSS and file settings. Omission preserves all current dynamic-view behavior. Physical-page and presentation creation tiles remain unavailable in the open-source designer; this amendment adds no publication adapter or collaboration capability.
